title: Certify control regret uniformly on an observation fibre without identifying its model
statement: For every model on the actual thickened observation fibre, a policy gradient bound G and common-region strong concavity mu>0 give global performance regret at most G^2/(2mu), provided actual global exclusion and the common policy-to-maximizer region hold.

requires: The actual nonempty exact or justified thickened measurement fibre
A declared convex control region (or every relevant policy-to-maximizer segment) containing the policy and all global maximizers
Uniform -Hessian F >= mu I, mu>0, and the policy-gradient bound ||grad F||<=G throughout that model fibre
Actual global exclusion of other optima
provides: For every model on the actual thickened observation fibre, a policy gradient bound G and common-region strong concavity mu>0 give global performance regret at most G^2/(2mu), provided actual global exclusion and the common policy-to-maximizer region hold.
assumptions: A small gradient at one point alone is insufficient
This mathematical subresult does not accept the source's whole numerical quantum-chain or sensor-performance claim
costs: Acquire the actual experiment error, policy, curvature, gradient and global exclusion certificates
Charge calibration, sensor implementation, all evaluations, precision, trials and physical actuation separately
contract.units: Regret has the original objective units; G and mu use the same declared control norm and units. Observation coordinates and model parameters are not interchanged.
contract.obstruction: Neither full model identification nor a free acquisition oracle is supplied. A narrow parameter interval is not by itself a regret certificate.

body: Strong concavity bounds F(u+h)-F(u) by grad F(u).h-mu||h||^2/2. Maximizing the latter quadratic gives G^2/(2mu). Convex-region or whole-segment validity is explicit so this step cannot cross an uncertified region. This is a source-exposed mathematical lemma, not a new novelty or practical-advantage claim.

evidence.range_scope: Actual fibre definition, global-exclusion/curvature/gradient hypotheses and the full quadratic proof; unit additionally makes segment validity explicit.
